results.answer: The foreign transaction fee on a debit card is 2.5% of the amount.
The foreign transaction fee on a credit card is 3.0% of the amount.
The cost to replace a lost credit card is 100,000 VND.
The annual fee for a credit card is 300,000 VND, and it is waived when the spending is at least 50,000,000 VND per year.
The bank charges 28% per year on an unpaid credit card balance, which is applied when the statement balance is not fully paid by the due date.
Yes, if your dispute about a payment you actually made is rejected after investigation, a handling fee of 80,000 VND applies.
You have 60 days from the payment date to report an unauthorized payment. If you report it after 60 days, the bank will review it on a case-by-case basis, and you may be liable for the amount.
As a provisional credit for an unauthorized payment, you will get your money back within 5 working days while the bank investigates the dispute.
No, if your card was locked because of a fraud dispute, the bank will replace it free of charge.
An OTP is valid for 3 minutes and is used for one payment only.
After entering 5 wrong OTPs, the card's online payments are paused for 30 minutes.
A single transfer in the app requires a biometric check from 10,000,000 VND or more.
